newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares weaken as market takes a breather.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares weaken as market takes a breather.

text.p: Sweden's stockmarket fell off Tuesday's record high close on Wednesday with brokers saying the market was lacking direction and taking a breather.
The Stockholm general index lost 0.73 percent to close at 2,130.61 after shares worth 3.8 billion crowns were traded.
Brokers expected the performance on Wall Street overnight to dictate movements on the Stockholm bourse on Thursday.

"If the Dow Jones falls tonight we will follow them in the morning," one broker said. "A move downwards after the recent rise is not unimaginable. It has been hard to find buyers after the recent gains."

Brokers said drugs major Astra was the focus of the day with U.S. partner Merck releasing its quarterly report and announcing sales of its key drug, the ulcer treatment Losec, rose 37 percent in the U.S. in the first nine months of 1996.
Astra rose three crowns during the day to close at 305.50 crowns, pulling the drug sector index up 0.16 percent.
Pharmacia & Upjohn fell 5.50 to 239 crowns, losing some of the gains it posted on Tuesday.
Market heavyweight telecoms giant Ericsson dropped two to 175.50 crowns.
